title: English Practice Quiz 0955
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: The hospital is ___ the bank and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for a position separating two things.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: She is interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective interested is followed by in.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
Which sentence uses the apostrophe correctly?
options: The guards' uniform is blue. (one guard)
questions.explanation: Guard's shows possession by one guard.
